device.name: Unitree Go2 velocity task in Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab (go2_omniverse)

facts.text: The upstream script defaults the Gymnasium task to Isaac-Velocity-Rough-Unitree-Go2-v0
The script creates the environment with gym.make(args_cli.task, cfg=env_cfg) after the Isaac Sim application has started
AppLauncher(args_cli) starts the Isaac Sim application before the environment is created
UnitreeGo2CustomEnvCfg extends LocomotionVelocityRoughEnvCfg
UnitreeGo2CustomEnvCfg replaces the scene robot with UNITREE_GO2_CFG
The action term is a JointPositionAction over every joint with use_default_offset=True and a scale of 0.5 in the base configuration
UnitreeGo2CustomEnvCfg reduces the joint-position action scale to 0.25
The physics timestep is 0.005 s and the policy action is applied every 4 physics steps
The episode length is 20.0 s
The policy observation concatenates base linear velocity, base angular velocity, projected gravity, velocity commands, joint positions, joint velocities, last actions and a height scan, in that order
The height scan is clipped to (-1.0, 1.0)
Projected gravity is corrupted with uniform noise in (-0.05, 0.05)
The height scanner samples a grid with 0.1 m resolution over a 1.6 m by 1.0 m extent
The velocity command ranges are all zero: lin_vel_x, lin_vel_y, ang_vel_z and heading are (0, 0)
The termination terms are a time-out and an illegal contact of the base body above a threshold of 1.0
The policy reads the observation group named policy
The main loop advances the environment with the policy actions
The environment base class is imported from isaaclab.envs, outside the clone
Isaac Sim 5.0 and Isaac Lab 0.54.3 are installed into a separate Python 3.11 virtual environment
The twinbot mode drives the simulated Go2's joints from the physical robot's /lowstate stream; the simulation mirrors the real state rather than commanding it

determinism.notes: the fake reseeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed), so one seed repeats its own trajectory; Isaac Lab draws from numpy/torch generators and its seeding was not observed, so the same seed is not claimed to reproduce an Isaac Sim trajectory

gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in (F0): no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator, sensor or noise model; the base motion and the height scan are placeholder kinematics and were never compared with an Isaac Sim run

the action space is published as an unbounded 12-value Box because the clone configures a joint-position action over every joint (custom_rl_env.py:195) and states no numeric action bound; the 12-value joint count comes from the external UNITREE_GO2_CFG (custom_rl_env.py:326), not the clone, and the real total_action_dim was not observed

the policy observation is concatenated into one 235-value vector: 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 base terms, 12 joint positions, 12 joint velocities, 12 last actions and a 17 x 11 height scan (custom_rl_env.py:167-183, :118-119); the real Isaac Lab observation_space shape and bounds come from the external environment and were not observed
the illegal-contact termination of custom_rl_env.py:255-257 is not modelled; only the 20 s time-out of custom_rl_env.py:298 truncates an episode
the reward is a constant placeholder, not the sum of the configured reward terms, because those terms are external Isaac Lab MDP functions
the fake draws its noise with Python's random.Random and returns Python floats rather than float32 arrays; a seed does not reproduce an Isaac Sim trajectory

the sim backend gymnasium.make('Isaac-Velocity-Rough-Unitree-Go2-v0') was not run: it needs Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, torch and a GPU (JAZZY.md:68-69), and the driver cannot pass cfg=UnitreeGo2CustomEnvCfg() because building that object needs the clone's imports, so a sim run would use the registered task's default configuration rather than the custom action scale and contact termination
twinbot mirrors a physical Go2's state into the simulation (README.md:29-37), but this driver serves the simulation only and never commands the real robot

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: on an e-stop the bridge stops stepping and refuses further step and reset calls until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation stays readable
